# VizRefra

> Text visualization for content teams and researchers. Turn a corpus of articles, transcripts, or feedback into a navigable topic map — no Python required.

VizRefra is a SaaS for content marketers, UX researchers, and academics who need to make sense of unstructured text fast. Upload articles, transcripts, support tickets, or survey responses; the app extracts themes, surfaces sentiment, and renders an interactive topic map. No code, no notebooks.

## Audience

- Content marketing teams analyzing competitor content
- UX/CX researchers parsing interview transcripts and survey responses
- Academics doing thematic analysis on qualitative data
- Customer-success teams reading support ticket batches

## What it does

- Upload text (CSV, transcripts, PDFs) and get a topic map in 60 seconds
- Sentiment + theme extraction with cited examples
- Filter, group, and export themed segments
- Compare two corpora side-by-side (e.g. before/after a change)

## Pricing

- Free: 1 project, 500 documents
- Pro: unlimited projects, comparative analysis, exports
